propwash.guide.scene.bandos.description: Find abandoned buildings to fly freestyle in
propwash.guide.scene.bandos.step.chest.t: Some bandos hide a chest with Propwash parts, often used – sometimes up on a catwalk or in a hayloft.
propwash.guide.scene.bandos.step.find.te: Bandos are abandoned buildings: barns, factories, water towers, piers or oil rigs. They are rare, match their biome and are never the same.
propwash.guide.scene.bandos.step.fly.tex: Doors, windows, holes in the roof, catwalks and gaps between beams are made for flying through – perfect for gaps and power loops.
With cheats, /locate structure #propwash:bandos shows the nearest bando. They only exist when the world generates structures.
propwash.guide.scene.bandos.step.map.tex: In survival, journeyman cartographers sell a bando map to the nearest unexplored bando. Sometimes one lies in a chest.
propwash.guide.scene.bandos.title: Bandos: abandoned spots
propwash.help.bando_map.summary: Leads to the nearest unexplored bando
propwash.help.bando_map.use.2: Sometimes in bando and cartographer chests
propwash.help.bando_map.use.3: Copy it with an empty map
propwash.help.bando_map.what.1: Explorer map to an abandoned building
